title: Dalvik's long and double values occupy adjacent register pairs
summary: Dalvik registers typically carry 32-bit data, and wide values use two adjacent registers; there is no even starting requirement for register pairs.
applies: Android DEX files and Dalvik instructions
detail: Method input is located at the end of the method's register bank, and wide parameters are counted as two spaces. Instance methods also take receiver references.
boundary: The register number is the slot of the virtual machine and cannot be interpreted as the native ARM register number.
relevance: Distinguish between the number of parameters and the number of register slots when restoring the smali parameter table.
